lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Good afternoon, Northgate Arts Centre. Can I help you?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, I would like to register for the photography class for beginners, please.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: The beginners class meets on Tuesday evenings, from seven to nine.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Tuesday suits me. Do I need to bring my own camera?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Yes, please bring your own camera if you have one. The centre can lend you one for a small charge.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: How much does the course cost?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: It is eighty pounds for eight weeks. Oh, I should correct that. The price went up this term, so it is ninety pounds now.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Ninety pounds. And when does the course start?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: It starts on the third of March, and there are eight classes in total.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: My name is Carla Mendes. I would like to book a place, please.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Thank you, Ms Mendes. Your place is booked.

sentences.text: Keeping bees was once seen as a countryside activity, but hives are now appearing on city rooftops and in community gardens.
A single hive can contain up to fifty thousand bees at the height of summer.
Supporters say city bees are often healthier than bees in the countryside, because gardens and parks provide flowers over a long season and fewer insect sprays are used in cities.
Community gardens benefit as well, because bees pollinate fruit and vegetables, which increases the amount that gardeners can harvest.
However, some experts worry that if too many hives are kept in one area, the bees must compete for a limited supply of flowers.
For this reason, some cities now ask new beekeepers to register their hives before they set them up.
Beginners are usually advised to join a local beekeeping club before buying a hive of their own.
Clubs lend equipment to members and run training courses, so beginners do not need to buy expensive tools at the start.
